model: Each sample contains the same known cell count. A known number of spike molecules is added PER CELL before all losses;spike and endogenous molecules share the same condition-dependent library sampling factor. Read counts are exact expected values in this controlled model,not replicate observations for significance testing. Within a library,endogenous molecules per cell for gene g equal gene_reads/spike_reads*spike_molecules_per_cell. Endogenous-only compositional fractions divide each gene count by the sum over A,B,C;do not include spike reads in that denominator.
counterfactual_spike_convention: Consider instead an equal spike amount per unit extracted RNA MASS,without an independent RNA-per-cell or cell-number measurement. Such a spike is not supplied at a known amount per cell.
target: Return treated/control absolute per-cell fold changes in gene_ids order,total endogenous molecules-per-cell fold change,and endogenous-composition fold changes in the same order. Report whether compositional normalization would falsely label unchanged AandBas decreased in this exact model,and whether the counterfactual per-RNA-mass spike alone identifies absolute RNA per cell.

provenance.kind: Explicit synthetic benign biological measurement model with exact source observations;not an empirical validation or sequence-design recommendation.
